params.train: 0..1 every chip deepens from light blue (its starting number) to deep blue (trained); survivors' chips follow
params.prune: 0..1 the weakest 32 tickets drop through the board in turn, leaving four
params.rewind: 0..1 the reel turns two turns back and the survivors' chips return to their light starting colour
params.fresh: 0..1 the survivors swap their starting numbers for new random ones (red); with train they deepen to dark red
params.lit: 0..1 the four survivors turn yellow: the winning ticket
